newsitem.title: USA: San Juan 540 MW unit seen off-line until Wed night.
newsitem.headline: San Juan 540 MW unit seen off-line until Wed night.

text.p: The 540 megawatt (MW) unit 4 at the San Juan coal-fired power plant in New Mexico was shut over the weekend due to a boiler tube leak, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Monday.
The unit was expected to return to service on Wednesday night.
San Juan's 350 MW unit 2 has been down since early this month for maintenance scheduled to finish May 5.
The plant's second 350 MW unit and another 540 MW unit were said to be operating normally.
The power plant is operated by Public Service Co of New Mexico.
